deployment.note: Hermes merge follows the agent block's own indent and refuses an inline agent value instead of writing a duplicate key.

harnesses.note: Backups take a fresh mtime so --prune-backups keeps the most recently taken ones, as README already describes.

maintenance.note: Document the separate docs link and command check and that CI and releases run both scripts.

models-agents.note: reviewer and explorer roles no longer assume a shell; deploy refuses shared agents directories; tracked per-agent overrides apply under local ones.

overlays-trust.note: State that the Paperclip target never carries local or private overlays and that the lint line cap for its fragment is larger.

prompts.note: Core rules yield the preamble and last line to a subagent role's own output format.

workflow-templates.note: Baseline when the guard was introduced; existing docs were not re-verified line by line.
